task.description:
Validate the test design produced by TEST-DESIGNER for SBX-04, SBX-05, SBX-06.

Check:
1. Every MUST acceptance criterion in SBX-04, SBX-05, SBX-06 has at least one runnable integration test
2. No SkipZigTest on MUST tests
3. Fixtures are isolated per test (unique IDs, defer cleanup)
4. Tests are self-contained (no shared mutable state between tests)
5. build.zig wires the new test file into the integration test targets
6. SBX-05 byte-identical response test is present (covers probe indistinguishability)
7. SBX-06 idle reclaim test is present

Return PASS or FAIL with specific gaps.

result.summary: SBX-04 (7 tests) and SBX-06 (5 tests) pass all checks. SBX-05 has two MAJOR gaps: TC-SBX-05-02 (cross-tenant sentinel) is not implemented — the combined test sbx05_02_03_all_sentinel_cases_byte_identical exercises wrong-principal-same-tenant (TC-SBX-05-03) in place of the required cross-tenant fixture, leaving SBX-05 AC2 uncovered. Additionally the SBX-05 spec declares 5 test cases but only 4 test blocks exist. All other checks pass: no SkipZigTest, per-test UUID fixtures, defer cleanup, BPM_TEST_DB_URL error guard present, build.zig wired at line 4563, probe-rate-429 test present, idle-reclaim test present.

gaps.description: sbx05_02_03_all_sentinel_cases_byte_identical does not set up a cross-tenant fixture. Case 1 exercises a nonexistent UUID (TC-SBX-05-01 scenario); Case 2 exercises wrong-principal-same-tenant (TC-SBX-05-03 scenario). SBX-05 AC2 requires a sandbox_id that physically exists in a second tenant, proving the tenant predicate suppresses it and produces the same byte-identical 403 sentinel. No second-tenant INSERT is present anywhere in the test file.

SBX-05 spec declares 5 test cases; only 4 test blocks are implemented (sbx05_01, sbx05_02_03, sbx05_04, sbx05_05). TC-SBX-05-02 is not present as a distinct test block. Spec-to-implementation count: 17 spec cases vs 16 test blocks (7+4+5).

result.next_action: Route FAIL back to TEST-DESIGNER for rework (rework_count 0 of max 1). Gaps: add cross-tenant fixture for TC-SBX-05-02 and split sbx05_02_03 into two distinct test blocks.
